messages:
Lina (People Ops): Heads-up — we have a surge of 6 new hires starting Mon 09:00 across SF site + remote. Two have passport e-verify exceptions. Need kiosk/courier plan and notary coverage. Can anyone cover badge escort and last-minute notary?
Alex K: I can do badge escort 08:45 — kiosk 2. Who's bringing the escort list?
Maria P: I have the escort list and welcome kits. FYI 2 laptops are stuck in staging, IT-OPS can you confirm reimage status?
IT-OPS: Pinged infra, reimage in progress. ETA ~2h. We'll try to finish tonight and mark assets for morning pickup.
BadgeBot: Badge printing queue length: 4. Estimated print start: 08:40. Use express template 'NewHire-Quick' to reduce dwell time.
Shaun L: For the passport e-verify holds, Notary on-call is booked. Recommend mobile notary vendor SignFleet — Lina, approve budget?
Lina (People Ops): Approved. Shaun, please send SignFleet the names & courier codes. Also one remote hire needs day-one benefits 1:1 — who can own scheduling?
Maria P: I can do a 30min benefits drop-in at 13:30 PT and send Zoom invite now.
Alex K: Quick note — lobby access codes rotated this morning, I'll DM Security the new QR link and update the welcome email.
Shaun L: On courier: can we reuse AM pickup slot? Sample payload for courier app:
```
{"slot":"AM-10","parcels":["KIT-789","KIT-790"],"notes":"onboarding kits + notary envelope"}
```
IT-OPS: Laptops will be staged in 'onboarding-lab' rack and tagged with temporary asset tags. If any need VPN pre-provisioning, say so now.
Alex K: One hire needs temporary admin to install Zoom & VPN — request temporary 'basic-admin' for 7 days. Approve? :thinking_face:
Lina (People Ops): Approved for onboarding scope only, auto-revoke in 7 days. Maria, add to preboarding checklist.
Maria P: Added: 'temporary admin: basic-admin, expiry 7d' to welcome doc. Also included a note about two e-verify exceptions so escorts have forms ready.
BadgeBot: Badge prints completed for 4/6. Two pending holds due to e-verify.
Shaun L: I'll meet SignFleet at 09:15 and escort them to kiosk 2. @Security please hold the doors briefly.
Security: Security: Roger — doors will be held 09:10-09:30. Please ensure valid photo IDs are ready to speed e-verify.
Lina (People Ops): Thanks team — once courier confirms pickup and notary booked I will post green checklist here. :party-parrot:
